REAL FINDING, owned by task atomicfile-options-unused-nothing-is-ever-fsynced. Zero non-test callers. Its doc claims it is 'used by writers that must preserve user-set permissions on managed files' — NO SUCH WRITER EXISTS. Every managed-file rewrite therefore resets mode to the 0o644 default.

STRUCTURAL SMELL, owned by task man-page-generator-is-a-test. Not dead: `make man` runs `VP_GEN_MAN=1 go test -run TestGenerateManPages ./cmd/vp/`, so the shipped man pages are generated BY A TEST and this function's only caller is that test. Deleting it breaks `make man`. The honest fix is a real cmd/gen-man main package, which would give it a non-test caller and remove this entry legitimately.

REAL FINDING, owned by the existing task zed-pane-capture-parity (Phase 1). This is the missing half of the documented Zed failure: zedAdapter.ResolveSource requires a Zed thread UUID, ListThreadIDs is the ONLY code in the tree that can enumerate one, and nothing calls it — so a thread cannot be found without hand-querying SQLite. Its doc comment cites a `--detect` smoke mode that DOES NOT EXIST anywhere in the tree. The gate rediscovered that task's root cause from source alone.

FALSE POSITIVE (Unmarshal-populated), NOT the note_path shape — the original defect was FIXED under task skill-frontmatter-paths-and-triggers-are-never-set (DECISION 205). Paths is now genuinely produced from disk: the shipped template internal/templates/templates/skills/startup-analyst/SKILL.md declares a real `paths:` list, skills.Parse yaml.Unmarshals it (frontmatter.go), it flows SkillDir.Frontmatter -> reconcile.go -> SkillItem, and renderCursorRule emits it into the Cursor rule's `globs:` line (target.go). The residual flag is the known gate/charter gap tracked by the write-only-field charter thread (203): the static heuristic cannot see yaml.Unmarshal as a producer and trips on the partial composite literal in target.go GrokHubItem, which sets only Description. By the gate's own STATED charter (Unmarshal-populated structs are exempt) this should be suppressed. The sibling field Triggers was DELETED in the same change. Verified: integration/skill_shims_test.go TestEmbeddedSkillPathsReachCursorGlobs drives a shipped template end-to-end and proves the declared paths reach the rendered globs.
